name: io.github.flashdata-dev/google-images
title: Google Images — FlashData
description: Google Images URLs, dimensions and source pages for visual research. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with google_images access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Filter Google Images by dimensions and retain source pages
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].images. Select entries whose imageWidth meets your threshold, then retain imageUrl, imageWidth, imageHeight and link to the original source page. Exclude unknown dimensions explicitly.
dev.flashdata.limits: This returns image metadata and URLs, not downloaded files or image reuse rights. Some fields can be absent.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
